highlights: Default to API payload playlists; public R2 snapshot fetch is opt-in with snapshotFetch=1
Reduces LV-SNAPSHOT-FETCH-FAILED noise from public playlist.json fetch failures
Treats page frozen / app-config navigation play() interruption as transient, not corrupted media
Ignores stale video onerror/watchdog events after playback token changes
Keeps media retry once, then session-skip for true repeated media failures
notes: Field-log stabilization build after overnight 1-TV test. Works with CMS v1.8.1+ and APP v9.2.
